page.overview:
Who is RoboCop?

OCP Crime Prevention Unit 001, better known as RoboCop, and formerly as Alex James Murphy, is a former Human police officer-turned Cyborg, known for his appearances in the franchise of the same name. A former Detroit police officer killed in the line of duty "remade" by Omni Consumer Products, RoboCop helped launch a recognized franchise of the science-fiction action genre that has been lauded for its themes of humanity and characterization.

RoboCop made his debut as a playable guest character in Mortal Kombat 11 as part of the Aftermath DLC Expansion, in addition to being as an announcer for the game's Arcade.

RoboCop, formerly Alex Murphy, is a police officer in a dystopian future Detroit who is transferred to the Metro West Precinct as part of OCP's drive to restructure the police department. As Alex was brutally murdered by a gang led by serial killer Clarence Boddicker, he is resurrected by an OCP executive Bob Morton as RoboCop, OCP Crime Prevention Unit 001.

RoboCop at first followed the three directives given to him:1. "Serve the public trust"2. "Protect the innocent"3. "Uphold the law"
